# LevelWorks

> LevelWorks (levelworks.org) is a $5/month web app for contractors and trades businesses: estimates, digital signatures, invoices, online card payments, automated recurring billing, client records, job notes and job-site photo updates, all in one place. Built by a working contractor for his own business first.

## What it does

- Unlimited professional estimates, sent by email or text as a link.
- Clients review and sign from any phone, tablet or computer; you are notified instantly.
- One-tap conversion of an estimate to an invoice.
- Clients pay invoices online by Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay or Google Pay; funds go straight to the contractor's bank account (processed by Stripe).
- Automated recurring billing for maintenance and service contracts on any schedule (monthly, quarterly, every four months, yearly), with automatic retries and instant alerts on a failed card.
- Your logo on every estimate and invoice.
- Job-site photo updates: before, during and after progress reports sent to the client with one tap.
- Client database, job management and job notes synced across devices.
- Push notifications when a client views or signs.
- Runs in the browser on iPhone, Android and desktop; installable to the home screen as a progressive web app. No app store download required.

## Pricing

- $5 per month, flat. Every feature included. No tiers, no add-ons, no contracts. Cancel anytime.
- 30-day free trial with full access, no credit card required. 60 days when signing up through a referral link.
- For comparison, most contractor estimating and invoicing apps charge $19 to $150 per month.

## Who it is for

Contractors, remodelers, painters, handymen, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, cleaning and any service business that sends estimates and invoices. Company: Level Works LLC, United States.
